name: Guided
description: Edge-preserving smoothing with a self-guided filter (box means of a local linear model).

inputs.name: src
inputs.description: Picture to filter, then the optional guide (FFmpeg's guidance=on), of the same size

params.name: radius
params.description: Radius of the box in pixels: the box is 2 * radius + 1 wide

params.name: eps
params.description: Regularisation: larger values smooth across stronger edges (compared with the variance of 0..1 values)

params.name: mode
params.description: fast: compute the model on every `sub`-th pixel, with the radius divided by `sub`

params.name: sub
params.description: Subsampling ratio of the fast mode

params.name: planes
params.description: Channels to filter, FFmpeg's bits on gbrp: 1 green, 2 blue, 4 red
